review_kind: Independent source review and Node VM execution of actual save reader; no browser or device test by this reviewer.

findings.status: FIXED by root; verified through actual controller DOM simulation
findings.problem: Truthy property lookups accept inherited or coercible values instead of an exact recipe identifier. Valid-JSON corrupt state can abort startup or prevent a seven-dish order bag.
findings.fix: Define isRecipeId = id => typeof id === string && ids.includes(id); use for bag, active, pending and recipe entry guards.
findings.resolution: Null-prototype recipe map plus exact string isRecipeId checks reject inherited identifiers, coercible objects and nested-array bags. Five malformed/corrupt save cases passed.

findings.status: FIXED by root in source; no browser layout verification available
findings.problem: Result panel contents may exceed a 320px-high landscape viewport, while the only continuation action is inside an overflow-hidden panel.
findings.fix: Allow result-panel overflow-y:auto; verify right/wrong result Next at 568x320 and safe-area heights. Root notified to check in browser.
findings.resolution: Result panel permits vertical scrolling. Physical viewport fit and iPhone Safari behavior remain untested.

passed_node_checks: Fresh save yields all seven unique string dish ids in order.
Saved pizza step 0 with 3 taps normalizes to step 1 with zero taps.
Saved pizza at final step normalizes to ready and zero taps.
source_review_observations: Normal correct serving increments rewards exactly once before opening the result and clears active, with pending guards against repeated serving.
Home during step animation cancels timer and normalizes completed step before saving.
Wrong serving preserves active/order/rewards; nextOrder starts the wanted dish.
Pointer cancellation, release, lost capture, window blur and resize release captured pointer; a completed step releases pointer to prevent one drag advancing multiple recipe steps.
Storage get/set/JSON errors are caught; save availability feedback is maintained.
All seven recipes are present, available in the picture menu, and each has four or five preparation steps.

controller_suite.label: DOM simulation with actual game scripts and DOM controls; no browser/layout/device claim
